authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 9: HEADER contains a hard pointer to the ACAD_GROUP dictionary.
problem: Every generated writer creates the ACAD_GROUP dictionary at reserved handle 0x0D and puts its entry in the named-objects dictionary, but the HEADER field was previously encoded as a null hard pointer.
independent_controls: LibreDWG 0.14 decodes the locally authored LINE drawings converted by ODA File Converter 27.1.0 at AC1018/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 with nonzero HEADER ACAD_GROUP hard pointers. A local AC1021 source of unverified provenance also has a nonzero pointer. These controls do not prove ODA acceptance of our output.
implementation: Pass the reserved group dictionary handle from both writer HEADER paths into the private HEADER encoder. The standalone protected HEADER encoder still uses zero. All versions share the object-emission path creating the group dictionary; public DWG publication requires the generated NOD and group frames and matching ACAD_GROUP entry before output finalization.

validation.tests: Modern generated HEADER handle streams are walked independently through the preceding references; assert the group hard pointer, following null MLINESTYLE hard pointer, named-objects hard-owner reference, CRC sealing, and following LINE readback. Existing sealing checks cover all six writer versions.
validation.physical_independent_reader: LibreDWG 0.14 decoded each from-scratch complete generated file: HEADER ACAD_GROUP (5,1,0x0D); target is a DICTIONARY owned by NOD 0x0C; one LINE decoded.

limits: ODA could not be rerun while the Mac session was locked; a corrected relationship is not a claim of full interoperability or proof that this was the ODA rejection cause. No generated DWG fixtures were committed.
